sqm.title: SQM
sqm.tips: When enabled, your router intelligently manages traffic to minimize latency and "bufferbloat" for smoother gaming and calls. Since SQM is resource-intensive, it is best suited for low-bandwidth or congested networks; on high-speed connections, enabling this may lead to a reduction in peak throughput performance.
sqm.qdisc_cake_tips: cake: Smart, automatic traffic shaping with the best overall latency control (recommended).
sqm.qdisc_fq_codel_tips: fq_codel: Simple and efficient fair-queueing with basic latency reduction.
sqm.tips_second: SQM affects traffic passing through the router as a gateway, including VPN Client traffic, but does not affect incoming traffic when the router is operating as a VPN Server.
sqm.cake_autorate_tips: Continuously sends small ICMP latency probes to reflector servers, observes round-trip delay, and dynamically lowers or raises the CAKE shaper bandwidth to suppress bufferbloat. It does NOT run active speed tests.
sqm.upload_tips: Set your maximum upload and download speeds first (input range: 1–10000) for traffic scheduling. Match them to your actual internet bandwidth for the best results.
sqm.network_acceleration_warning: This feature cannot work together with {network}. Enabling it will automatically disable Network Acceleration to ensure proper operation.
sqm.client_speed_limit_warning_tips: This feature cannot work together with Client Speed Limit. Enabling it will automatically remove all client speed limits.
sqm.cake_tips: Smart, automatic traffic shaping with the best overall latency control (recommended).
sqm.fq_codel_tips: Simple and efficient fair-queueing with basic latency reduction.
sqm.repeater_tips: may help when RF conditions vary.
sqm.cellular_tips: recommended — signal and cell load swing the rate.
sqm.usb_tethering_tips: recommended, but mind the phone's data plan.
sqm.probe_subtitle: Defaults are tuned to work — adjust only if you know what you are doing.
sqm.probe_server_addresses_tips: Comma-separated, used for network quality probing.
sqm.concurrent_probes_tips: Must be less than probe server count; higher values increase CPU usage.
sqm.cake_autorate_desc: Latency-driven shaper that reduces or raises CAKE bandwidth in real time based on probe RTT — there is no active speed test, only lightweight pings. Recommended whenever the WAN bandwidth fluctuates; not needed on stable links.
sqm.queue_discipline_tips: Choose the queueing algorithm. cake offers smart, automatic traffic shaping with the best overall latency control. fq_codel provides simple and efficient fair-queueing with basic latency reduction.
sqm.intelligently_manage_traffic_tips: Smart Queue Management intelligently manages traffic to minimize latency and "bufferbloat" for smoother gaming and calls. Best suited for low-bandwidth or congested networks; on high-speed connections, enabling this may reduce peak throughput. SQM affects traffic passing through the router as a gateway, including VPN Client traffic, but does not affect incoming traffic when the router operates as a VPN Server.
sqm.probe_interval_tips: Lower values = faster response but higher CPU usage.
sqm.small_traffic_tips2: Autorate pings the reflector servers around the clock. With the default settings (4 probes @ 0.3 s) it consumes roughly 1–5 KB/s of background traffic, plus a small amount of router CPU. The amount is negligible on Ethernet/fiber/cellular monthly plans, but on strictly metered links (e.g. pay-per-MB cellular, phone hotspot data caps) it can add up to ~100–400 MB per month.
sqm.idle_detection_threshold_tips: When the transfer rate falls below this value, the connection will be considered idle. This value must not exceed 25% of the configured speed limit.
sqm.speed_test_less_than_1m_tips: The detected bandwidth is less than 1 Mbps. Please enter the bandwidth manually.
